set.about: The words that ask for each voice command and the order the commands are tried, read by both parsers (packages/observation/src/voiceGrammar.ts and services/voice/grammar.py) so the two cannot drift. Each rule names the contract action it forms. match: words (any phrase as whole words, a phrase with ' ... ' between two parts asks for the second part later in the same sentence), start (the request starts with a phrase), whole (the request is a phrase), year (a year said, read by code), seconds (a phrase, then a number of seconds), name (a thing the request names), rest (anything left becomes a question). target, for an action on one finding: view (said alone, it acts on what is in view), which (said alone, it asks which one), about (said alone, it is no command and the next rule is tried), named (it applies only when the words name or point at a thing that is found). with holds fixed fields of the action; the first modifier whose word the request holds changes them. namesRefusedBefore is the rule before which a name the sky does not hold, or cannot reach, is refused. A rule that changes the scene acts only when every word of the request is accounted for: by the rule's own phrase and modifier words, the names it reads, the pointing words, for a rule with a target the describing words it reads, the numbers its code reads, and the unchanging words, each group with why it is there. Any other word means no action (not_a_request), and a second such request in the sentence means neither (two_requests). A rule whose action is in describingActions only describes and keeps its reading. folds are read first: each typographic apostrophe or quote as its plain one (answers-3b v4). Written by hand from the phrases both parsers read on 2026-11-12 (answers-3b).

unchanging.why: An article names no other thing: fly to the star asks what fly to star asks.
Politeness asks for nothing more and nothing less.
A greeting or an assent said before a request is no request of its own.
A request put as a polite question or a wish is the same request; a word that changes it is not here, so it still stops the action.
Sounds and words speech fills a pause or agrees with; they ask for nothing.
The words that lead to the thing a request is about or to where it is: take me there, to Vega; the brightest star in the photo.
When a request is said, or that it is said again, changes nothing about what it asks: fly there now.
The recording is what every request acts on: naming it changes nothing (restore the photo).
Whom the scene is shown to does not change the scene: show me the planets.
The app's own name, said to it.
